Basic Features of the Present Age

entscheidungen.deutsch: Title: Die Anweisung zum seligen Leben
entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's lectures on religion of 1806. Anweisung means guidance or instruction.

optionen.en: The Way towards the Blessed Life

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's 1801 report to the wider public, "clear as the sun", on what his philosophy really is.

entscheidungen.deutsch: Older English titles that translate Wissenschaftslehre
entscheidungen.frage: Wissenschaftslehre itself stays untranslated. But some established English titles translate it as "Science of Knowledge", such as Fichte's 1810 outline and Schelling's Abhandlungen of 1796/97.

optionen.en: keep the established titles as published
optionen.hinweis: Recognizable in libraries; inconsistent with the text.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling insists that what is not (Greek μὴ ὄν) is not nothing: creatures come from das Nichtseyende, not from das Nichts.

optionen.hinweis: Parallel to "that which is"; never confused with nothing.

entscheidungen.frage: Late Schelling's Aristotelian term: potency passes over into Aktus. German also has Akt and Handlung for "act".

optionen.en: act; pure act (actus purus kept in Latin)
optionen.hinweis: Short; collides with Akt and Handlung.
Clear for Aristotle; collides with Wirklichkeit.

entscheidungen.frage: Late Schelling calls God the absolute Prius: what comes before all being, not in time but in principle.
In the identity philosophy the absolute is the Indifferenz of subject and object: not apathy, but the absence of difference.
Kant's term for what is not conditioned. The young Schelling plays on be-ding-en, "making into a thing".

optionen.hinweis: Older translation of the early essays; more idiomatic.

entscheidungen.frage: Late Schelling sets the Einzigkeit of God against his Einheit (unity) in his account of monotheism.
The identity philosophy's word for everything as one whole. Lowercase "the all" is barely readable.
In the Ages of the World God's essence before all being is Lauterkeit; Schelling writes "das lautere Seynkönnen". He also uses rein (pure).

optionen.hinweis: Keeps the clarity of lauter; rare.

entscheidungen.frage: Hundreds of words begin with Ur-. The drafts render the prefix as original, primal or primordial, not consistently.

optionen.en: primal for persons and acts, primordial for structures
optionen.hinweis: A rule by sense; needs judgment.

entscheidungen.frage: Period physiology: Reiz is the stimulus, Reizbarkeit the capacity to respond to it. Schelling also uses Irritabilität.

optionen.hinweis: Usual English physiology; merges two words.

entscheidungen.frage: In the philosophy of nature the drive by which animals build nests and hives; in the philosophy of art the artist's drive.

optionen.hinweis: By context; the German word stays visible.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's philosophy of nature works with the chemistry of the 1790s: vital air for oxygen, caloric for heat, phlogiston.

optionen.hinweis: Faithful; the history of science stays visible.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling writes the Latin Centrum (im Centro); in the Freedom essay the dark Centrum of the creature.

optionen.hinweis: Natural; the Latin stays visible in the reader.
Keeps the Latin term, as in the current Freedom essay translation.

entscheidungen.frage: The empirical students of nature Schelling argues with (Kielmeyer, Ritter, Humboldt). The English word "scientist" did not yet exist.

optionen.hinweis: Period English; now suggests field biology.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's nature is an infinite productivity that must be held back to produce anything. Fichte uses the same word.

optionen.hinweis: Used for both; psychological overtone today.

entscheidungen.frage: In the System of Transcendental Idealism nature is unconscious intelligence. The word is older than Freud's unconscious.
In the identity philosophy a Reflex is the mirroring of the absolute in the finite, not an act of reflection.

optionen.hinweis: Keeps it apart from reflection; sounds physiological.
Clear; collides with Widerschein and Gegenbild.

entscheidungen.frage: The Freedom essay asks how God can have Persönlichkeit; Schelling also writes Personalität. The drafts disagree on "personhood".
Kant's Erkenntnis is cognition. Schelling's identity philosophy often means knowledge as a result, as in Erkenntnis Gottes.
In the philosophy of art Anmut and Grazie both mean grace; in theology Gnade is grace too.

optionen.hinweis: Established; the German word stays visible.

optionen.en: charm for Anmut, grace for Grazie

entscheidungen.frage: For Schelling, as for Schlegel, Poesie is productive making in general (Greek poiesis), wider than verse.

optionen.hinweis: Natural; the wider sense needs the note.

entscheidungen.frage: The arts that shape matter: sculpture, painting, architecture. Schelling's 1807 Academy address is on their relation to nature.
The Freedom essay: beneath all order lies das Regellose, which can always break through again.

optionen.hinweis: As in the current translation; political overtone.

entscheidungen.frage: Böhme's word for the fierce, consuming principle in God, taken up in the Freedom essay.

optionen.hinweis: As in the current translation; more violent.

entscheidungen.frage: In the Freedom essay evil is a Zerrüttung, a disordering of the forces, like disease.

optionen.hinweis: As in the current translation; sounds final.

entscheidungen.frage: Eckhart's word for letting go of one's own will, which Schelling takes up. Heidegger later made it famous.

optionen.hinweis: Plain, as in a recent translation.

entscheidungen.frage: In the Ages of the World God's first act is to contract, to close in on himself. Schelling uses both the German and the Latin word.

optionen.hinweis: Established; the German word stays visible.
As in one translation; less physical.

entscheidungen.frage: The restoration of all things at the end of time (Greek apokatastasis), an old heterodox hope.

optionen.hinweis: As in the current translation; vague.

entscheidungen.frage: In the Philosophy of Mythology the time before all history, as distinct from merely early times.

optionen.hinweis: As in the current translation; near-synonyms.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's unfinished work on the past, present and future of God.
Late Schelling's learned ignorance: a knowing that knows it does not know. He also uses Unwissenheit (ignorance).
What is above being (Greek τὸ ὑπερόν): late Schelling's name for God before all being.
Schelling plays Urstand against Gegenstand (object): a being that stands before all objecthood.

optionen.en: primal being (with a note on the pun)
optionen.hinweis: Readable; the pun goes into the note.
A recent scholarly coinage; keeps the pun.

entscheidungen.frage: Late Schelling's name for purely rational, "negative" philosophy, as against positive philosophy.

optionen.hinweis: Literal; as in the current translation of the Berlin lectures.
Shorter; could mean any rational science.

entscheidungen.frage: Late Schelling explains mythology through the peoples' Göttervorstellungen, which arise in consciousness by necessity.
Schelling's term for the earliest astral religion, the worship of the stars.

optionen.hinweis: The English term for star worship.
Older form; confused with a real religious community.
Keeps Schelling's form; unknown in English.

entscheidungen.deutsch: Indian and Near Eastern names (Wischnu, Schiwa, Brama, Melkart)
entscheidungen.frage: Schelling uses the German transliterations of the 1840s. Should they be modernized in English?

optionen.en: modern English forms (Vishnu, Shiva, Brahma, Melqart)
optionen.hinweis: Recognizable; Schelling's form stays visible in the reader.
Faithful; look like errors to English readers.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling builds an argument on the two divine names of the Old Testament.

optionen.hinweis: As Schelling writes it; the period form.

entscheidungen.frage: God's becoming human in Christ, a central theme of the Philosophy of Revelation.

optionen.hinweis: Literal and traditional; clashes with "human being".

entscheidungen.frage: The third person of the Trinity. The King James Version, the model for Bible quotations, says "Holy Ghost".

optionen.hinweis: Period and King James English; archaic.

entscheidungen.frage: The mystic Jacob Böhme stands behind much of Schelling's middle period. The drafts disagree on the spelling of his name.

entscheidungen.deutsch: Pronouns for das Absolute and das Seyende
entscheidungen.frage: Late Schelling moves from neuter terms (das Seyende: it) to the personal God (er: he). The shift is part of his argument.

optionen.en: follow the German gender (it for neuter, he for masculine)
optionen.hinweis: Keeps the shift; "it" may then refer to God.

entscheidungen.frage: Some translations write "Being" for Sein, especially in Schelling. The drafts write "being" in lowercase.

entscheidungen.deutsch: Title: Vorlesungen über die Methode des akademischen Studiums
entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's 1803 lectures on the university, known in English under a shorter title.

optionen.en: Lectures on the Method of Academic Study

entscheidungen.deutsch: Title: Bruno oder über das göttliche und natürliche Princip der Dinge
entscheidungen.frage: The established English title of Schelling's dialogue reverses "divine and natural".

optionen.en: Bruno, or On the Natural and the Divine Principle of Things
Bruno, or On the Divine and the Natural Principle of Things

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's private lectures of 1810 for a small circle in Stuttgart.

entscheidungen.deutsch: Title: Philosophische Untersuchungen über das Wesen der menschlichen Freiheit
entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's Freedom essay of 1809.

optionen.en: Philosophical Investigations into the Essence of Human Freedom

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's Würzburg lectures of 1804.

optionen.hinweis: As in the existing partial translation.

optionen.en: System of the Whole of Philosophy

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling and Hegel have four words, ideal and ideell, real and reell. English has two.

optionen.en: ideal / real for all four; the German stays visible in the reader
optionen.hinweis: Natural; the distinction lives in the data.
Visible distinction; a modern psychological word.
Fits some everyday uses; wrong in technical ones.

entscheidungen.frage: A late Fichte word for the act of directing one's intuition onto something. It occurs only in Fichte.

optionen.hinweis: Natural; loses the link to Anschauung.

entscheidungen.frage: In the late Wissenschaftslehre the absolute appears, and appears to itself. Fichte fuses this into one word.

optionen.hinweis: Clear; no longer a single term.

entscheidungen.frage: The late Fichte: "the Bildungskraft, known under the name Einbildungskraft (imagination)". Not to be confused with Bildung (education).
Late Fichte: the being or nature of the image, and consciousness as a whole considered as image.

optionen.hinweis: A scholarly coinage; sounds like a doctrine.

entscheidungen.frage: In ordinary German a mess. In the late Fichte two terms that exist only "through each other".

optionen.hinweis: Like the other nominalized particles; unmistakable.

entscheidungen.frage: Being alive as such, the quality of life; frequent in Hegel, technical in the late Fichte.
Fichte's name for those who practice his philosophy: "wir, die Wissenschaftslehrer".

optionen.hinweis: Literal; but Lehrer here is not a teacher.

entscheidungen.frage: The first of Fichte's five ages of humanity (Characteristics of the Present Age): reason working blindly, as instinct.

optionen.hinweis: As in the established translation; says what Fichte means.
Literal; Hegel uses the same phrase.
Short; sounds like a psychological faculty.

entscheidungen.frage: From 1799 Schelling coins anorgisch next to the ordinary unorganisch; both mean the inorganic.

optionen.hinweis: Natural; the German word stays visible in the reader.
Keeps the coinage visible; rare English.

entscheidungen.frage: The Freedom essay distinguishes das Böse (evil as an act of will) from das Übel (harm, misfortune, malum).

optionen.hinweis: Keeps "evil" for das Böse; slightly old-fashioned.
Natural; too narrow for metaphysical malum.

entscheidungen.frage: Late Schelling asks how God is God: his Gottseyn is not his being as such, but his lordship over being.

optionen.en: divine being; that which is divine
optionen.hinweis: As in the current translation; collides with Gottheit and Wesen.

entscheidungen.frage: The Philosophy of Revelation on Christ's self-lowering in the incarnation (Philippians 2).

optionen.hinweis: Theological standard; today it means embarrassment.
